Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: initial discovery - pipeline anomalies

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the discovery call this week. Our operations team ran a quick audit of the joint pipeline and we found ~42 'ghost' entries: accounts that appear both in our DataForge sales queue and in Redwood's pipeline, but with mismatched owner fields and conflicting next-steps. That mismatch is causing duplicate outreach and confused account handoffs (see sample rows).

I've attached a short CSV (dataforge-ghost-report.csv) with customer IDs, assigned owner on our side, and the corresponding Redwood record ids where we see the overlap. High level observations: 
- ~60% are lead-to-opportunity duplicates from Q2
- Several are co-sell prospects that lack a formal mutual action plan (MAP)
- A handful show different region tags (US vs. EMEA) likely from historical imports

We'd like to get a short alignment call next week to: 1) decide canonical ownership for the overlaps, 2) agree on canonical tagging, and 3) map a fast reconciliation workflow so both sales teams stop duplicating outreach.

Availability: Mon/Tue morning PT works best for us. Attaching the CSV now.

Regards,
Anil Rao
Head of Partnerships, DataForge
--

On Fri, Sep 11, 2026 at 2:02 PM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed immediate next steps:
> 1) Quick 30-min sync early Mon (09/14) at 9:30am PT to agree scope and owners

I joined the call this morning and logged the notes in the MAP template. Short summary here: 
- Scope: 42 overlapping records from DataForge audit (priority: 12 enterprise / 30 mid-market)
- Ownership rule: canonical owner = the organization with most recent active touch in the last 90 days unless customer has an active signed engagement (contracts@acmesys.com or equivalent)
- Tagging: add partner_source=DataForge, partner_owner=<email>, region_tag normalized from free-text to standardized US/EU/APAC dropdown
- Reconciliation flow: weekly batch reconcile (CSV merge), and an immediate manual triage for the 12 enterprise names (assign to human SRs)

Action owners assigned during call:
- Jonas Weber: lead on tagging rules, write a merge script and schedule (due EOD Wed 09/16)
- Karthik Iyer: export definitive Redwood ids and create a HubSpot dedupe job (kickoff Tue 09/15)
- Marissa Cole: customer outreach cadence and joint messaging templates (first drafts due 09/17)
- Stephanie Nguyen: finalize MAP with DataForge and signoff on enterprise triage list

I've dropped the preliminary ownership decisions into ownership-decision-log.txt and uploaded it to the Drive. Anil / Priya — please review the enterprise priority list and confirm if any of the 12 are currently in active buying cycles on your side so we can avoid any handoff mistakes.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Channel ghost entries reconciliation and ownership plan — agreed next steps

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Finalizing here so we have a single source of truth. This message supersedes earlier thread items where there was ambiguity.

Confirmed decisions (final):
- Canonical ownership criteria: most recent active touch (90d) unless a signed engagement exists (contracts email as proof)
- Region normalization: Jonas to apply US/EU/APAC tags via script; Karthik to upload normalized fields to HubSpot
- Reconciliation cadence: weekly automated merges + immediate manual triage for 12 enterprise overlaps
- Communications: Marissa to send coordinated outreach to the enterprise list on Thu 09/17; DataForge to mirror messaging the same day

Deliverables & deadlines: 
- Jonas: merge script + tagging rules (due 2026-09-16 EOD)
- Karthik: HubSpot dedupe job kickoff (2026-09-15)
- Marissa: joint outreach templates (first draft 2026-09-17)
- Stephanie: publish signed MAP in Drive and update HubSpot records after triage (2026-09-18)

Links & artifacts: Drive MAP — https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1GfA2b-example | HubSpot:HS-987654 | DocuSign:DS-4455

Appreciate the fast collaboration — Steph
